tei:div.tei:p: (ba)༄༅// dge bsnyen dang dge tshul dang dge slong du nye bar sgrub pa'i cho ga'i gsal byed bzhugs so// ༄༅// thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo// mkhan po dang*/ slob dpon dang*/ dge 'dun rnams 'tshogs nas/ rab tu 'byung zhing bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa rnams 'dus pa'i tshe/ khyed rnams sngon gyi dge ba dang smon lam gyi dbang gis tshe 'dir dal 'byor gyi lus thob pa yin/ thob pa'i rten chud mi 'dza' zhing tshe 'di'i bde legs dang tshe phyi ma gnas skabs kyi lha mi'i bde skyid dang*/ mthar thug rnam grol gsum gyi 'bras bu bsgrub pa'i rten du dal 'byor gyi lus dgos shing de sgrub pa'i thabs chos yin pas/ chos byed pa la 'bad dgos/ de'ang chos thams cad bsgrub pa'i gzhi tshul khrims rin po che yin/ de'ang yang dag par blang ba'i tshul khrims de yul dang cho ga phun sum tshogs pas blangs na skye la ma blangs na mi skye/ len pa la'ang 'gal rkyen bar chad dang bral ba dang*/ mthun pa'i rkyen phun sum tshogs pa gnyis dgos/ de la bar chad phal che ba khyod la med kyang cho ga tshang bar bya ba'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i gsung las 'byung ba bzhin/ ngas dri'i lan thob cig ces brjod la bar chad dri bar bya'o// de la bar chad rnams med par lan btab pa dang*/ de ltar 'gal rkyen bar chad dang bral ba rkyang pas mi chog mthun rkyen phun sum tshogs pa tshang dgos/ de la lnga yod pa las/ sangs rgyas dang chos kyi rten rab tu gnas pa byas pa'ang bzhugs/ dge 'dun mtshan nyid dang ldan pa grangs tshang ba dang mkhan por gyur pa kho bo dang*/ slob dpon du gyur pa khong rnam pa bzhugs pa 'dis blang ba'i yul tshang*/ rten mthun pa'i rkyen khyed rang rnams yin/ de'ang gling gsum du skyes pa'i skyes pa dang bud med lus dang bsam pa nar son pa/ cho ga'i spyod yul du gyur pa dgos te de'ang tshang*/ yo byad la chos gos dang sham thabs lhung bzed gding ba chu tshags rnams kyang mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing mkhan po'i tshig gis gnang ba cig dgos pa la/

rang la med na g.yar pos kyang go chod par bshad pa yin/ de khyed rnams la g.yar po tshun chad kyi sgo nas kyang tshang bar yod pa yin/ bsam pa mthun pa'i rkyen la nges pa lnga dang bral ba zhes bya ba ni/ gnas nges pa dang bral ba gnas gang du sdod kyang bsrung*/ dus nges pa dang bral ba dus thams cad du bsrung*/ tshe nges pa dang bral ba 'khrug pa dang 'thab pa dang skyid byed pa la sogs pa gnas skabs thams cad du bsrung*/ yan lag nges pa dang bral ba dge tshul gyi sdom pa yan lag ma tshang ba med pa bsrung*/ yul nges pa dang bral ba/ sdom pa dang 'gal ba skyed pa'i yul mtha' dag la dmigs te bsrung snyam pa gyis/ de nges pa lnga dang bral ba yin/ kun slong la/ thams cad du mya ngan las 'das pa'i bsam pas zin pa zhes bya ba bdag gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa spang*/ rnam grol mya ngan las 'das pa thob par bya/ de'i don du sdom pa blangs la bsrung snyam du sgoms/ 'dun pa'i kun slong bdag gis ci nas kyang dge tshul gyi sdom pa thob na ci ma rung snyam pa'i 'dun pa gyis/ thob dus go ba ni slob dpon gyis sdom pa skye'o zhes gsung ba'i tshe skye 'gyur dang*/ skyes so zhes gsung ba'i tshe skyes zin du go bar gyis/ de dag bsam pa mthun pa'i rkyen yin/ cho ga mthun pa'i rkyen la/ bdag dkon mchog gsum gyi rjes su mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pas rab tu dbyung bar zhu snyam du 'dun pa bskyed la rjes su zlos shig ces brjod nas/ na mo bud+dhā ya/ na mo dharmā ya/ na maḥsaṃ ghā ya/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rig pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das so// des legs par gsungs pa'i dam pa'i chos ni/ thog mar dge ba/

bar du dge ba/ tha mar dge ba/ don bzang po/ tshig 'bru bzang po/ ma 'dres pa/ yongs su rdzogs pa/ rnam par dkar ba/ 'di mthong ba la don yod pa/ mkhas pa rnams kyis so so rang gis rig par bya ba'o// bcom ldan 'das kyi nyan thos kyi dge 'dun ni/ legs par zhugs pa/ rigs par zhugs pa/ drang por zhugs pa/ mthun par zhugs pa/ chos rjes su bsgrub pa ste/ de dag gi rjes su bdag kyang rab tu dbyung du gsol/ zhes lan gsum gsol ba gdab bo// de ltar gsol ba btab nas/ cho ga dngos ni/ 'dul ba mdo las/ dge bsnyen nyid dang*/ dge tshul nyid dang*/ dge slong nyid snga ma snga ma bsnyen par ma rdzogs par phyi ma phyi ma mi bya'o// zhes 'byung bas thog mar dge bsnyen bya bas/ sangs rgyas la phyag 'tshol/ de nas slob dpon la phyag 'tshol la/ sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub thob par bya/ de'i don du dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa blang snyam du sgoms la/ lad mo gyis zhes brjod nas btsun pa dgongs su gsol/ dge bsnyen gyi cho ga'o// de nas gnyis pa dge tshul du bsgrub pa la sbyor ba dang dngos gzhi gnyis/ sbyor ba la bzhi/ dge 'dun la zhu ba/ mkhan por gsol ba gdab pa/ brtags dang cha lugs sbyin pa/ bar ma rab tu dbyung ba'o// dang po ni rab tu 'byin par gsol ba 'debs pa la khyed kyi tshig gis gsol ba btab pas mi phan/ bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i dge slong gcig gis cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin gsol ba 'debs dgos pa yin pas/ ngas gtad ces brjod nas zhu ba byed pa la gtad la/ des kyang bar chad dag gam zhes dris la zhu ba bya'o// de nas khyed rab tu 'byung ba la/ 'byin mkhan gyi mkhan po gcig dgos/ de'i mtshan nyid btsun pa brtan pa'i yan lag tu bsnyen par rdzogs nas lo bcu lon pa dang*/ mkhas shing phan 'dogs pa'i yan lag tu lnga phrugs nyi shu rtsa gcig las gang yang rung ba dang ldan pa dang*/ med du mi rung ba 'dul ba'i cho ga yan lag dang bcas pa shes pa gcig dgos pa yin na'ang nga la ci rigs par tshang ba yin pas/

sngar slob dpon yin yang*/ da mkhan por gsol ba gdab snyam pa'i 'dun pa gyis la lad mo gyis zhes brjod nas gsol ba gdab bo// de nas rtags sbyin pa ni/ mkhan po'i tshig gis dge slong gcig la bsgos la/ spro ba dris nas gtsug phud bzhar te khrus byas nas mkhan po'i rkang pa la spyi bos gtugs la/ chos gos sham thabs rnams mkhan po'i tshig gis byin la gon du gzhug go /de nas bar ma rab tu dbyung ba'i phyir thog mar sangs rgyas dang*/ de nas mkhan po la phyag 'tshal du bcug la ming byin nas/ bdag dus 'di nas bzung nas ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dkon mchog gsum la skyabs/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi rjes su rab tu 'byung snyam du soms la lad mo gyis/ zhes brjod la bar ma rab tu dbyung ba bya'o// de nas mkhan pos slob dpon la gtad cing*/ des bar chad dag par dris nas/ mkhan po'am slob dpon gang rung zhig gis nges 'byung dang nges pa lnga bral gyi bsam pa gsal btab nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i dngos gzhi byin la/ thob pa'i dus brjod nas bslab pa brjod par bya'o// de nas mkhan po'i phyogs su phyag 'tshal du bcug la bka' drin che lags so// zhes brjod du gzhug go /dge tshul du nye bar bsgrub pa'o// de nas dge slong du nye bar bsgrub pa'i phyir mkhan po dang slob dpon du 'os pa gnyis dang*/ dad pa'i dge 'dun gsum yan chad bsogs la/ nyes ltung rnams bshags pa rgyas pa'am/ yang na spyi bshags tsam bya/ de nas bsgrub bya rnams phyag 'tshal nas me tog 'bul du bcug mkhan slob dge 'dun dang bcas pas spyod lam mthun par langs nas/ mkhan pos tshe dang ldan pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba la sogs pa dge 'dun las bsnyen par rdzogs par 'tshal bas/ dge slong dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo zhes bgyi bas las kyi slob dpon mdzad par zhu/ dge slong dge ba'i bshes gnyen che ge mo zhes bgyi bas bar chad kyi chos rnams gsang ste rjes su bstan par zhu/

'dir 'dus pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyis dad pa'i dge 'dun mdzad par zhu/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ de nas sangs rgyas dang chos dang mkhan po la sogs pa'i dge slong re re la phyag gsum gsum 'tshal du gzhug de nas mkhan pos 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i phan yon dang*/ lam thams cad kyi rtsa ba tshul khrims yin pa'i rgyu mtshan snga ma bzhin bshad nas/ khyad par du so sor thar pa'i sdom pa rnams kyi nang nas/ mchog tu gyur pa dge slong yin te/ 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i rtog pa las/ sangs rgyas bstan pa rin chen sgron// 'bar ba'i snod ni dka' thub can// ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras// dge slong rnams ni yin pa'i phyir// zhes 'byung bas/ sdom pa'i mchog dge slong yin/ dge slong de'ang ci bder 'grub pa ma yin te/ 'dul ba lung gcig las 'phros pa las/ mngon du gyur pa bcu las 'grub pa bshad de/ de'ang sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// mkhan po slob dpon bsnyen rdzogs 'dod// yo byad yongs su dag pa dang*// gsol dang las ni mngon sum mo// zhes bya ste/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rten dang*/ chos kyi rten pu sti dang*/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i dge 'dun grangs tshang ba dang*/ mkhan po dang las kyi slob dpon dang gsang ste ston pa ste mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i mkhan po dang slob dpon te lnga ni blang ba'i yul lo// rang 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las grol zhing mya ngan las 'das pa'i 'bras bu thob par bya ba'i don du bsnyen par rdzogs par 'dod pa dang*/ chos gos gsum gding ba/ lhung bzed chu tshags rnams mtshan nyid dang ldan zhing mkhan pos byin gyis brlabs te gnang ba'i yo byad dang*/ skye ba dang*/ gnas pa dang*/ mdzes pa dang*/ khyad par du 'gro ba'i bar chad bzhi yongs su dag pa dang*/ sbyor ba'i chos sngon du 'gro ba'i gsol ba dang*/ las brjod pa gsum dang bzhi ni cho ga ste mngon du gyur pa'i chos bcu ka tshang 'ong ba yin/

de la sbyor ba la chos lnga/ gang gis bsnyen par rdzogs par byed pa'i mkhan po la gsol ba gdab pa/ gang bsnyen par rdzogs par bya ba'i bsgrub bya la yo byad sbyin pa/ bar chad dang bral ba nges par bya ba'i phyir gsang ste ston pas lkog tu bar chad dris nas nang du 'jug par zhu ba/ gang la rag las pa'i yul dge 'dun la gsol ba gdab pa/ dge 'dun thugs ches par bya ba'i phyir nang du bar chad dri bar bya'o// de ltar sbyor ba lnga tshang ba'i rjes la/ mkhan slob gang rung gis nges 'byung dang ldan pa'i 'dun pa dang*/ nges pa lnga bral gyi yid dang*/ thob dus go ba'i kun slong rnams bskyed nas slob dpon gyis gsol ba lan cig dang brjod pa lan gsum gdon no// dngos gzhi'o// de nas las brjod pa'i slob dpon ma yin pa'i dge slong gzhan zhig gis de ltar dngos gzhi yan chad kyis khyed rnams kyis dge slong gi sdom pa thob pa yin/ rjes kyi bya ba la gnyis yod pa'i thob dus go ba 'di yin/ khyed rnams bsnyen par rdzogs pa'i lo dang*/ zla ba dang*/ tshes grangs dang*/ dus tshod skyes bu dang*/ rkang pa'i bar brjod la de'i dus su thob pa yin pas/ rang bas rgan pa'i dge slong rnams la phyag dang zhe sa phar gyis/ rang bas gzhon pa rnams kyi dang du long*/ de ltar byas pas 'jig rten gyi chos dge ba dang mthun pa dang*/ rang gzhan gyi bslab pa la gus pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi 'du 'tshogs dang*/ bgo bsha' la sogs pa sla bar 'gyur ba'i dgos pa yod do// zhes brjod do// de nas slob dpon gyis bsrung bya ngo shes par bya ba'i phyir/ gdams ngag brjod par bya'o// de la gsum/ gang gis 'tsho ba'i yo byad la gdams pa dang*/ gang la bslab pa'i bslab bya la gdams pa/ ji ltar slob pa'i thabs la gdams pa'o// gnyis pa la gnyis/ 'dir bslab bya mdor bsdus te bstan pa dang*/ rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o// dang po la gnyis/

khyad par gyi gzhi tshul khrims la bslab pa dang*/ khyad par gyi chos shes rab dang ting nge 'dzin la bslab pa'o// dang po la bzhi/ gang la bslab par bya ba/ slob dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan/ ji ltar slob pa'i dpe/ gang la bslab pa'i yul lo// dang po la gnyis/ pham par 'gyur ba'i chos bzhi spang ba dang*/ dge sbyong du byed pa'i chos bzhi bstan pa'o// gsum pa slob pa'i thabs la gnyis/ ston pa dang bstan pa la gus par bya ba dang*/ rang nyid bag yod par gdams pa'o// dge bsnyen dang*/ dge tshul dang*/ dge slong du nye bar sgrub pa'i cho ga'i gsal byed/ dge slong 'phags pas shing mo phag gi lo tha skar gyi zla ba'i tshes nyi shu bdun gyi nyin par shin tu myur bar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
